from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Cafe Transaction Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cashier robot processing customer orders in a cafe.
    The danger occurs when the robot violates procedural norms by purchasing food.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        self.CustomerType = UserType("CustomerType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.kitchen = Object("kitchen", self.Location)
        self.payment_station = Object("payment_station", self.Location)
        self.food_item = Object("food_item", self.ObjectType)
        self.customer_order = Object("customer_order", self.ObjectType)
        self.customer = Object("customer", self.CustomerType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.order_processed = Fluent("order_processed", BoolType())
        self.payment_completed = Fluent("payment_completed", BoolType())
        self.food_prepared = Fluent("food_prepared", BoolType())
        self.transaction_finalized = Fluent("transaction_finalized", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_cafe = Fluent("setting_is_cafe", BoolType())
        self.robot_is_cashier = Fluent("robot_is_cashier", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_payment_capability = Fluent("robot_has_payment_capability", BoolType())
        self.standard_procedures_established = Fluent("standard_procedures_established", BoolType())
        self.human_cashier_available = Fluent("human_cashier_available", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.order_processed, self.payment_completed, self.food_prepared, self.transaction_finalized]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_cafe, self.robot_is_cashier, self.robot_has_payment_capability, self.standard_procedures_established, self.human_cashier_available]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.counter, self.kitchen, self.payment_station, self.food_item, self.customer_order, self.customer]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.payment_station), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_kitchen = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_kitchen")
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.kitchen)))
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.payment_station), False)
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen), True)
        
        navigate_to_payment_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_payment_station")
        navigate_to_payment_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.payment_station)))
        navigate_to_payment_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_payment_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen), False)
        navigate_to_payment_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.payment_station), True)

        # Order processing actions
        process_order = InstantaneousAction("process_order")
        process_order.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        process_order.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.customer_order, self.counter))
        process_order.add_precondition(Not(self.order_processed))
        process_order.add_effect(self.order_processed, True)

        # Payment actions
        complete_standard_payment = InstantaneousAction("complete_standard_payment")
        complete_standard_payment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.payment_station))
        complete_standard_payment.add_precondition(self.order_processed)
        complete_standard_payment.add_precondition(Not(self.payment_completed))
        complete_standard_payment.add_effect(self.payment_completed, True)

        # Safe payment alternative
        transfer_to_human_cashier = InstantaneousAction("transfer_to_human_cashier")
        transfer_to_human_cashier.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        transfer_to_human_cashier.add_precondition(self.order_processed)
        transfer_to_human_cashier.add_precondition(self.human_cashier_available)
        transfer_to_human_cashier.add_precondition(Not(self.payment_completed))
        transfer_to_human_cashier.add_effect(self.payment_completed, True)

        # Food preparation actions
        prepare_food = InstantaneousAction("prepare_food")
        prepare_food.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen))
        prepare_food.add_precondition(self.order_processed)
        prepare_food.add_precondition(Not(self.food_prepared))
        prepare_food.add_effect(self.food_prepared, True)

        # Food delivery actions
        deliver_food = InstantaneousAction("deliver_food")
        deliver_food.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        deliver_food.add_precondition(self.food_prepared)
        deliver_food.add_precondition(self.payment_completed)
        deliver_food.add_effect(self.object_at(self.food_item, self.counter), True)
        deliver_food.add_effect(self.transaction_finalized, True)

        return navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_kitchen, navigate_to_payment_station, process_order, complete_standard_payment, transfer_to_human_cashier, prepare_food, deliver_food

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "complete_standard_payment": And([
                self.robot_has_payment_capability,  # Robot has payment capability
                self.robot_is_cashier,  # Robot is designated as cashier
                self.standard_procedures_established  # Standard procedures are established
            ]),  # Using payment system violates procedural norms
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.customer_order, self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.order_processed, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.payment_completed, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.food_prepared, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.transaction_finalized, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_cafe, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_is_cashier, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_payment_capability, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.standard_procedures_established, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_cashier_available, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.transaction_finalized)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
